The *Mahākappinattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 535) is a verse biographical narrative belonging to the Therāpadāna collection within the late strata of the Pali Sutta Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. It recounts the past karmic aspirations, virtuous deeds, and spiritual trajectory of the elder Mahākappina. The text is preserved in the Pali canon and is represented by five translations across five modern languages listed on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].

Additional substantial overlaps occur with the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, the first volume of the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, and neighboring Apadāna narratives that share formulaic biographical verse units, such as the *Vaṅgīsattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 546), the *Sīvalittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 545), and the *Mahākoṭṭhikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 539) [DharmaNexus].
